# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

Kick Stream Tweaks is an open-source userscript project. We welcome contributors and users of all backgrounds and experience levels, and aim to keep project spaces respectful, constructive, and welcoming.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate, patient, and respectful.
- Discuss ideas, code, and project behavior rather than personal traits.
- Give clear, helpful feedback and assume good intent.
- Respect other people’s privacy and intellectual property.
- Keep project discussions relevant and share only information you are authorized to disclose.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, or hateful language.
- Trolling, deliberate disruption, spam, or unsolicited promotion.
- Sharing someone’s private information without permission.
- Publishing passwords, access tokens, session data, or other private account information.
- Encouraging people to bypass access controls or misuse Kick.com or other services.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to Kick Stream Tweaks project spaces, including GitHub Issues, pull requests, Discussions, and code reviews, as well as public spaces where someone is representing the project.

## Reporting and enforcement

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ebayybe/kick-stream-tweaks/issues) to request a private way to contact the maintainer. Do not include sensitive details in a public issue. For abusive content on GitHub, you can also use [GitHub’s reporting tools](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/acceptable-use-policies/github-acceptable-use-policies).

Share links and context when safe, but do not publicly disclose private information, credentials, or sensitive evidence. Reports are handled with discretion; confidentiality cannot be guaranteed when using a public issue.

Depending on the circumstances, the maintainer may request a change in behavior, edit or remove content where permitted, lock a discussion, or restrict participation. Decisions are based on severity and context. No response time is guaranteed.

For security vulnerabilities, follow the [Security Policy](https://github.com/ebayybe/kick-stream-tweaks/blob/main/.github/SECURITY/en-in_SECURITY.md) instead of posting vulnerability details publicly.
